recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-shot photograph of three young men in casual early-2000s streetwear leaning against a classic vintage convertible on a sun-drenched city street, featuring high-contrast lighting and a distinct top-right typographic lockup.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects leaning against the horizontal line of the car hood
Low-angle perspective emphasizing height and presence
High-key sunlight creating sharp shadows and bright highlights
Graphic logo and text anchored in the upper right sky area
coreInvariants: Baggy denim jeans with visible creasing
Classic American convertible car as a central prop
Urban background with brick buildings and storefronts
Direct eye contact from the central subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally but staggered in depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the blue shirt acts as the primary focal point, flanked by two others.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the central figure's face, down the line of the car, and up to the graphic lockup in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The bright, washed-out sky in the upper right provides a clean area for branding.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated blues and indigos from denim and shirts.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm browns and reds in the clothing and brickwork.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white highlights on the car and sky.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value with moderate saturation; colors are grounded but brightened by harsh sunlight.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly vibrant synthetic colors

letterConstructionRules: Heavy weight with rounded outer corners
Uniform stroke width for the main logo
Condensed, blocky proportions for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Circular elements integrated into the letterforms
Custom swoosh or orbital ring encircling the primary text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, rounded geometric logo paired with a rigid, condensed block subtitle for structural contrast.

preserve: The interlocking nature of the logo
The condensed blocky feel of the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the tech-forward, geometric Y2K aesthetic of the main logo.
Matches the condensed, heavy-weight block style of the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo of three men in 2000s streetwear (baggy jeans, graphic tees) leaning on a classic 1960s convertible on a sunny city street. High contrast, bright sky in the top right.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a custom geometric logo in blue with an orbital ring in the top right corner, followed by a condensed bold red-brown subtitle directly underneath.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle low enough to make the subjects look tall?
Is the sky in the top right bright enough to serve as a text background?
Are the jeans sufficiently baggy and textured?
Does the logo have a rounded, tech-inspired feel?

adjustableVariables: Specific streetwear items (e.g., bandana vs. cap)
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subjects

mustAchieve: Authentic Y2K film-like grain and contrast

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the car looks like a vintage American model.
Check that the lighting creates sharp, realistic shadows on the ground.
Verify the typography is legible against the bright sky.
Confirm the overall mood is confident and casual.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban street setting + vintage car prop + low-angle group portrait + Y2K streetwear + top-right geometric branding lockup.
